title: DensiTok: Making Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting See More Views Than It Is Given
title_zh: DensiTok：让前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅技术看到比输入更多的视角

paragraphs.en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene in a single forward pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a network trained across many scenes. Its quality, however, degrades sharply as the number of input images drops. The bottleneck is upstream of the reconstruction heads: from a few unposed views, the internal representation they read carries no evidence for unobserved regions, leaving holes, floaters, and blur. The common remedy supplies that evidence as pixels, synthesizing extra views with an image or video generator and re-encoding them, which is costly and not 3D-consistent by construction. We instead densify the evidence itself. We present DensiTok , a plug-in module for pretrained feed-forward 3DGS models that densifies their internal geometry tokens directly, making a frozen backbone behave as though it had observed many more views than it was given. DensiTok compresses those tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of the unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens that the original reconstruction heads. The same module design can be integrated into different pretrained predictors while keeping each backbone and its reconstruction heads frozen. Completion in a low-dimensional latent space requires no image synthesis or additional encoder passes. Across three pretrained backbones and two benchmarks, DensiTok consistently improves sparse-view reconstruction and recovers much of the gap to dense-view reconstruction. Project page: https://hydragon.co.kr/DensiTok .
paragraphs.zh: 前馈式三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）通过单次前向传播重建场景，用跨多个场景训练的神经网络取代了针对每个场景的优化过程。 然而，随着输入图像数量的减少，其重建质量会急剧下降。 瓶颈出现在重建头的上游：从少数未定位的视角出发，它们读取的内部表示不包含任何关于未观测区域的证据，从而留下空洞、漂浮物和模糊区域。 常见的解决方法是作为像素提供这些证据，即利用图像或视频生成器合成额外视角并重新编码，但这种方法成本高昂，且本质上无法保证三维一致性。 我们则选择直接对证据本身进行稠密化。 我们提出了 DensiTok——一个为预训练前馈式 3DGS 模型设计的插件模块，它能直接稠密化模型的内部几何标记，使冻结的主干网络表现得如同它观测到了比实际输入更多的视角。 DensiTok 将这些标记压缩到紧凑的潜在空间中，通过单次流匹配步骤（以相机几何结构为条件）补全未观测视角的潜在表示，再将其解码为原始重建头可识别的标记。 相同的模块设计可以集成到不同的预训练预测器中，同时保持每个主干网络和其重建头的冻结状态不变。 在低维潜在空间中进行补全无需图像合成或额外的编码器处理步骤。 在三种预训练主干网络和两个基准测试中，DensiTok 持续提升了稀疏视角的重建效果，并显著缩小了与密集视角重建之间的性能差距。 项目页面：https://hydragon.co.kr/DensiTok .

paragraphs.en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting predicts cameras, geometry, and appearance in a single network pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a model amortized over many scenes. This makes reconstruction practical from unposed, unconstrained image collections, and recent backbones accept an arbitrary number of input views. Such models ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) share a common anatomy: a geometry encoder maps the input images to a set of view-aligned geometry tokens, and camera, depth, and Gaussian heads decode that shared representation into the final reconstruction. Their quality, however, tracks the visual evidence they are given. The right side of Fig. 1 plots reconstruction quality against the number of input views for several recent backbones, and it degrades in the few-view regime that motivated feed-forward reconstruction in the first place. The cause sits upstream of the heads: a handful of unposed images gives the encoder little cross-view evidence, so its tokens describe only the surfaces that were actually observed. Occluded and uncovered surfaces have no tokens at all, and the heads turn that gap into holes, floaters, and blurred novel views. What the model lacks, then, is not pixels but tokens. This suggests a different target: rather than acquiring the views it never saw, synthesize the geometry tokens those views would have produced.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅技术通过单次网络推理即可预测相机位姿、几何结构和外观，用可在多个场景间摊销成本的模型取代了逐场景优化。 这使得基于无姿态标注、无约束的图像集进行重建成为现实，而近期的骨干网络还能接受任意数量的输入视角。 这类模型（Jiang 等，2025；Liu 等，2025；Lin 等，2025）具有共同的架构：几何编码器将输入图像映射为一组与视角对齐的几何标记，而相机、深度和高斯头则将该共享表示解码为最终的重建结果。 然而，其重建质量取决于所输入的视觉证据的充分性。 图 1 右侧展示了若干近期骨干网络的重建质量与输入视角数量之间的关系，在视角较少的情况下，质量会下降——而这正是最初推动前馈式重建的动机所在。 问题的根源在于编码器之前：少数几张无姿态标注的图像无法为编码器提供足够的跨视角证据，因此其生成的标记仅能描述实际观察到的表面。 被遮挡和未暴露的表面则完全没有对应的标记，而解码头会将这种缺失转化为空洞、漂浮物和模糊的新视角。 因此，模型所缺乏的不是像素，而是几何标记。 这提示我们应设定不同的目标：与其试图获取模型从未见过的视角，不如合成这些视角本应产生的几何标记。

paragraphs.en: Existing remedies differ mainly in where they supply the missing evidence. The dominant line of work operates in image space, either synthesizing extra input views with a multi-view or video diffusion model ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) , or repairing those renderings, and refitting the scene to them ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . Both incur two separate costs: running a large generative model at full image resolution, and then running the geometry encoder again over the enlarged set of views. Because pixels are not a shared 3D representation, consistency across generated views is encouraged but never enforced, so the reconstruction must fit views that disagree with one another. More fundamentally, pixels are a detour. The reconstruction needs only tokens for the missing viewpoints. These methods produce entire RGB frames instead, which the encoder then compresses into those tokens, so most of what the generator produced is discarded immediately. A second line of work supplies no new evidence at all, and instead trains feed-forward architectures specialized for sparse views, extracting as much as possible from the correspondences the input views do provide ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Smart et al., 2024 ) . Such models remain bounded by what those views cover, and they are standalone architectures tied to a small, fixed number of views. Closest to our setting, recent work ( Jang et al., 2026 ) generates directly in token space, but without a compressed latent it must run cascaded multi-step generators on features with over a thousand channels, so generation stays expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法的主要区别在于它们补充缺失证据的位置不同。 主流的研究路线在图像空间中进行操作，要么使用多视角或视频扩散模型（Gao et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2025）合成额外的输入视图，要么修复这些渲染结果，并据此重新拟合场景（Chen et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2025）。 这两种方法都会产生两种独立的成本：以完整图像分辨率运行大型生成模型，然后对扩展后的视图集合再次运行几何编码器。 由于像素并非共享的三维表示，生成的各视图之间的一致性虽被鼓励，但从未被强制执行，因此重建结果必须适应彼此不一致的视图。 更根本的是，像素是一种绕道。 重建过程只需要缺失视角对应的标记即可。 这些方法反而会生成完整的 RGB 帧，再由编码器将其压缩为这些标记，因此生成器产生的大部分内容会被立即丢弃。 另一条研究路线则完全不引入新证据，而是训练专门针对稀疏视图的前馈架构，从输入视图提供的对应关系中尽可能提取信息（Chen et al., 2024a；Xu et al., 2025a；Smart et al., 2024）。 这类模型仍然受限于这些视图所覆盖的内容，并且是独立架构，只能绑定少量固定的视图。 最接近我们设定的是近期的研究（Jang et al., 2026），该研究直接在标记空间中进行生成，但由于缺乏压缩后的潜在表示，必须在通道数超过一千的特征上运行级联的多步生成器，因此生成过程仍然成本高昂。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DensiTok , a plug-in that densifies the geometry tokens of a pretrained feed-forward 3DGS model so that its heads reconstruct as if from far more views. As shown in Fig. 1 , DensiTok sits between the geometry encoder and the reconstruction heads, with the encoder frozen and the heads either frozen or minimally adapted. The encoder’s output is naturally organized as a sequence of per-view token sets, one for each input image. DensiTok augments token sets for viewpoints that were never observed, so the heads receive the representation of a dense capture even though only a few images were encoded. Doing this directly on the tokens is costly: the heads read tokens from several layers of the encoder, and each layer has over a thousand channels in current backbones. DensiTok instead treats the whole stack of layers as one object: it compresses them into a single compact latent per view, completes the unobserved views in that latent space, and expands the result back into tokens for every layer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DensiTok，这是一个插件，能够增强预训练前馈 3DGS 模型中的几何标记密度，使其重建结果如同来自更多视角一样。 如图 1 所示，DensiTok 位于几何编码器和重建头之间，其中编码器保持冻结，而重建头则保持冻结或仅进行最小程度的调整。 编码器的输出天然组织为一系列每个视角的标记集合，每个输入图像对应一个集合。 DensiTok 会增强那些从未被观察到的视角的标记集合，因此即使只编码了少数几张图像，重建头也能获得密集采集的表示。 直接在标记上执行这一操作成本高昂：重建头需要从编码器的多个层读取标记，而当前主干网络中每一层的通道数都超过一千。 相反，DensiTok 将整个层堆栈视为一个整体：它将其压缩为每个视角的一个紧凑的潜在表示，在该潜在空间中补全未观察到的视角，然后将结果扩展回每一层的标记。

paragraphs.en: Two components realize this design. The first is a variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) with Level-Adaptive Modulation (LAM-VAE) . Its encoder predicts how much each feature level should contribute for each token, fuses the features accordingly, and compresses the fused tokens into compact latents. This lets a single latent stand in for all layers without fixing in advance which layers matter, since that varies across backbones and even across scenes. The second is a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) for Geometry Latent Augmentation : it extends the latent sequence with the unobserved views, generating their latents from the observed ones in a single flow-matching ( Lipman et al., 2022 ) step, conditioned on their cameras. Since the input is unposed, these cameras are not given. The backbone’s own camera head predicts them for the observed views, and the cameras of the new views are interpolated along the path through those predictions, so the new views densify the captured trajectory rather than extrapolate beyond it. paragraphs.en: We evaluate DensiTok on RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) and DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) with three representative feed-forward 3DGS backbones: AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , WorldMirror ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Feed-forward 3DGS amortizes reconstruction across scenes by using a single network to predict Gaussian attributes, cameras, and depth from a set of images in one pass. Posed methods build explicit correspondence machinery, with pixelSplat ( Charatan et al., 2024 ) using epipolar matching, MVSplat ( Chen et al., 2024a ) constructing cost volumes, and DepthSplat ( Xu et al., 2025a ) adding monocular depth priors. Splatt3R ( Smart et al., 2024 ) , NoPoSplat ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , PF3plat ( Hong et al., 2025 ) , and SelfSplat ( Kang et al., 2025 ) remove the pose requirement for sparse unposed inputs. More recent general backbones, including AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , WorldMirror ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , accept an arbitrary number of unconstrained views and jointly predict cameras, geometry, and Gaussians, typically by pairing a large geometry transformer with lightweight decoding heads. All of these models, however, are bounded by what their inputs show. With only a few views, overlap is limited, pose and depth are ambiguous, so the geometry tokens describe only the visible parts of the scene. Therefore, they render everything the tokens do not cover as holes, floaters, and blurred novel views. DensiTok instead treats sparse-view reconstruction as a completion problem inside the representation, augmenting token sets for additional viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈式 3DGS 通过单次处理一组图像，利用单个网络预测高斯属性、相机和深度，从而将不同场景的重建过程摊销到一次操作中。 基于姿态的方法构建了显式的对应关系机制：PixelSplat（Charatan 等，2024）使用极线匹配，MVSplat（Chen 等，2024a）构建代价体积，而 DepthSplat（Xu 等，2025a）则引入了单目深度先验。 Splatt3R（Smart 等，2024）、NoPoSplat（Ye 等，2025）、PF3plat（Hong 等，2025）和 SelfSplat（Kang 等，2025）消除了稀疏无姿态输入对姿态的要求。 更近期的通用主干网络，包括 AnySplat（Jiang 等，2025）、WorldMirror（Liu 等，2025）和 Depth Anything 3（Lin 等，2025），能够接受任意数量的无约束视角，并联合预测相机、几何结构和高斯分布，通常通过将一个大型几何变换器与轻量级解码头相结合来实现。 然而，所有这些模型都受到其输入内容本身的限制。 当仅有少数几个视角时，重叠区域有限，姿态和深度也难以确定，因此几何标记只能描述场景中可见的部分。 因此，它们会将所有标记未覆盖的区域渲染为空洞、漂浮物以及模糊的新视角。 DensiTok 则将稀疏视角的重建视为表示内部的一个补全问题，通过扩展标记集来融入更多视角的信息。

paragraphs.en: Image-space generative priors are typically incorporated in two ways. The first augments the sparse input set with pose-controlled synthetic views before reconstruction, as in CAT3D ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , VistaDream ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and Bolt3D ( Szymanowicz et al., 2025 ) . The second starts from a coarse 3DGS reconstruction, renders it along novel camera trajectories, and uses a video or multi-view generative model to refine or complete the rendered sequence, as in MVSplat360 ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , FlowR ( Fischer et al., 2025 ) , VideoScene ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , GSFixer ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , and G4Splat ( Ni et al., 2026 ) . Both can synthesize plausible content for unobserved regions, but the generative step operates in RGB or generic video latent spaces with no shared 3D representation to respect. Consequently, inconsistencies across the generated views turn into geometric artifacts. Both also incur two separate costs: a generative model runs for many sampling steps at image resolution, and the scene must then be reconstructed from the enlarged set of views. DensiTok instead generates in the backbone’s own token space, so the completed representation is decoded into one Gaussian scene by the same heads, with no image synthesis and no second reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 图像空间生成性先验通常以两种方式融入。 第一种方式是在重建之前，用通过姿态控制的合成视图来增强稀疏的输入集，例如 CAT3D（Gao 等人，2024）、VistaDream（Wang 等人，2025a）和 Bolt3D（Szymanowicz 等人，2025）。 第二种方式则是从粗略的 3DGS 重建开始，沿新的相机轨迹进行渲染，并利用视频或多视图生成模型来优化或补全渲染序列，例如 MVSplat360（Chen 等人，2024b）、FlowR（Fischer 等人，2025）、VideoScene（Wang 等人，2025b）、GSFixer（Yin 等人，2025）和 G4Splat（Ni 等人，2026）。 这两种方法都能为未观测到的区域合成合理的内容，但生成步骤是在 RGB 或通用视频潜在空间中进行的，没有需要遵循的共享 3D 表示。 因此，生成的不同视图之间会出现不一致，从而产生几何伪影。 这两种方法还会产生两种独立的成本：生成模型需要以图像分辨率运行多个采样步骤，随后还必须根据扩展后的视图集重建场景。 DensiTok 则直接在主干网络的自有令牌空间中生成内容，因此最终的表示由相同的头解码为一个高斯场景，无需图像合成，也无需第二次重建。

Therefore, GLD runs cascaded multi-step generators on them, decodes RGB with a separately trained decoder. DensiTok differs on each point. Which levels carry the most useful information can vary across backbones and even across scenes, so rather than fixing a subset of levels in advance ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , we let each token decide how much every level contributes. All operations in this paragraph act on one token at a time, so we drop the view and token indices and write 𝐟 ℓ ∈ ℝ d f \mathbf{f}_{\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{f}} for the token’s feature at level ℓ \ell . A gating network then decides how much each level contributes. It summarizes each 𝐟 ℓ \mathbf{f}_{\ell} with a shared linear layer, concatenates the L L summaries, and outputs one logit per level through an MLP. Because the MLP sees all L L summaries at once, the logit of each level depends on the others, so the gate compares levels rather than scoring each in isolation. A softmax turns the logits into weights α 1 , … , α L \alpha_{1},\dots,\alpha_{L} that sum to one. We use gains g ℓ = L ​ α ℓ g_{\ell}=L\,\alpha_{\ell} rather than the weights themselves: the gains average to one, so uniform weights recover the plain concatenation of all levels, and gating acts as a reweighting around that baseline instead of shrinking the input by a factor of L L . paragraphs.en: where 𝐖 ℓ \mathbf{W}_{\ell} is a learnable linear projection that maps level ℓ \ell to the width of the VAE encoder transformer. Equivalently, one can concatenate the gain-weighted levels and apply a single linear layer. The fused tokens of all n n observed views form one sequence that enters the VAE encoder transformer, which follows the alternating frame and global attention of VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025c ) . Frame blocks attend among the tokens of one view, global blocks attend across all views, and 2D rotary position embeddings ( Su et al., 2024 ) encode each token’s position on the patch grid. For every token the transformer outputs a Gaussian posterior over a d z d_{z} -dimensional latent, parameterized by a mean 𝝁 0 ∈ ℝ d z \bm{\mu}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}} and a log-variance log ⁡ 𝝈 2 ∈ ℝ d z \log\bm{\sigma}^{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}} , with d z = 4 d_{z}=4 in our main setting.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 𝐖 ℓ \mathbf{W}_{\ell} 是一个可学习的线性投影，它将层级 ℓ \ell 映射到 VAE 编码器变换器的宽度。 等价地，可以将增益加权的各层级进行拼接，然后应用一个单一的线性层。 所有 n n 个观测视图的融合标记构成一个序列，该序列输入到 VAE 编码器变换器中，其遵循 VGGT（Wang et al., 2025c）的交替帧注意力和全局注意力机制。 帧块在单个视图的标记之间进行注意力计算，全局块则在所有视图之间进行注意力计算，而二维旋转位置嵌入（Su et al., 2024）则编码每个标记在图块网格上的位置。 对于每个标记，变换器都会输出一个关于 d z d_{z} 维潜在变量的高斯后验分布，该分布由均值 𝝁 0 ∈ ℝ d z \bm{\mu}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}} 和对数方差 log ⁡ 𝝈 2 ∈ ℝ d z \log\bm{\sigma}^{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}} 参数化，在我们主要设定的场景中 d z = 4 d_{z}=4。

paragraphs.en: Unobserved views enter as pure noise, so their cameras are the only signal that tells the DiT which view to generate. We therefore encode the cameras of all N N views as Plücker rays. For every patch token of every view, we compute the ray through that patch center, so the Plücker ray embedding has the same K K -token layout as the latents. The few tokens that do not correspond to a patch, such as the camera token, receive a learnable embedding instead. These embeddings, together with the time τ i \tau_{i} (zero for observed views, t t for unobserved ones), condition every DiT block through adaptive LayerNorm (AdaLN) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) . The blocks alternate frame and global attention in the same pattern as the VAE encoder, so that noisy unobserved views gather evidence from the clean observed views in the global blocks. The DiT predicts the flow velocity with respect to increasing t t , from clean latents toward noise, and the sampler integrates this velocity backward from t = 1 t=1 to t = 0 t=0 with Euler steps, resetting the observed views to 𝐙 obs \mathbf{Z}^{\mathrm{obs}} after every step so they never drift; the result is the completed tensor 𝐙 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{Z}} . Training supervises only the unobserved views, including the finetuning that reduces sampling to a single Euler step.

paragraphs.en: The DiT is conditioned on the cameras of all N N views, yet at inference only the n n observed views come with images, so the N N cameras have to be obtained differently at training and inference. sents.en: The DiT is conditioned on the cameras of all N N views, yet at inference only the n n observed views come with images, so the N N cameras have to be obtained differently at training and inference.

paragraphs.en: During training, the dataset provides ground-truth cameras { 𝐠 i gt } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{g}^{\mathrm{gt}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} for all N N views. They cannot be used as n n -view conditions directly: the backbone reconstructs at an arbitrary scale, so its predicted cameras { 𝐠 ^ i obs } i = 1 n \{\hat{\mathbf{g}}^{\mathrm{obs}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n} live in a differently scaled world, and a DiT trained on raw ground-truth cameras would face a mismatch at inference, where only predicted cameras exist. Both sets of cameras are expressed relative to the first observed view, following the convention of the backbone’s camera head, so the two worlds already share their global rotation and translation and differ only in scale. We remove this last difference by rescaling all ground-truth camera centers by a single factor, the ratio of the spread of the predicted centers to that of the ground-truth centers over the observed views, and denote the aligned cameras by { 𝐠 i aligned } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{g}^{\mathrm{aligned}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} . paragraphs.zh: 在训练期间，数据集为所有 N 个视图提供了真实相机 { 𝐠 i gt } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{g}^{\mathrm{gt}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}。 它们不能直接用作 n 个视图的条件：主干网络以任意尺度进行重建，因此其预测的相机 { 𝐠 ^ i obs } i = 1 n \{\hat{\mathbf{g}}^{\mathrm{obs}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n} 存在于一个尺度不同的世界中；如果 DiT 在原始真实相机上进行训练，那么在推理阶段（此时仅存在预测相机）就会出现不匹配的问题。 这两组相机都是相对于第一个观测视图来表示的，遵循了主干网络相机头的惯例，因此这两个世界已经共享了全局旋转和平移，仅在不同尺度上有所差异。 我们通过将所有真实相机的中心点按一个单一因子重新缩放来消除这一最后差异：该因子是预测中心点与真实中心点在观测视图上的分布跨度之比，并将对齐后的相机表示为 { 𝐠 i aligned } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{g}^{\mathrm{aligned}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}。 DiT 是在这些对齐后的相机上进行训练的，因此它所见到的始终都是将在推理阶段遇到的世界中的相机。

paragraphs.en: At inference no ground-truth cameras exist, and the predicted cameras { 𝐠 ^ i obs } i = 1 n \{\hat{\mathbf{g}}^{\mathrm{obs}}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n} are themselves the reference, so no alignment is needed. paragraphs.en: DensiTok is trained in three stages, with the geometry encoder frozen throughout. In Stage 1, the VAE with Level-Adaptive Modulation is trained to reconstruct the geometry tokens of the frozen geometry encoder. In Stage 2, the DiT for geometry latent augmentation is trained on top of the frozen VAE with the rectified flow-matching objective on the unobserved views. At this stage, we can keep the Gaussian head frozen or minimally finetune it, as detailed in Appendix A.2 . In Stage 3, the model is finetuned for one-step sampling by fixing the time of the unobserved views at t = 1 t=1 , so that a single Euler step maps noise directly to the completed latents.
paragraphs.zh: DensiTok 的训练分为三个阶段，且几何编码器在整个过程中保持冻结。 在第一阶段中，采用层级自适应调制的 VAE 被训练用于重建已冻结的几何编码器的几何标记。 在第二阶段中，基于已冻结的 VAE，对用于几何潜在增强的 DiT 进行训练，并使用未观测视角上的修正流匹配目标函数。 在此阶段，我们可以保持高斯头冻结，或对其进行最小程度的微调，具体细节见附录 A.2。 在第三阶段中，通过将未观测视角的时间固定为 t = 1，对模型进行一步采样微调，从而使得单次欧拉步能将噪声直接映射到完整的潜在表示。

paragraphs.en: We train and evaluate DensiTok separately on RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) and DL3DV-10K ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , using ordered sequences of N = 16 N=16 view in the main setting. For evaluation, we use fixed sequences spanning three difficulty levels based on endpoint image overlap, with nested sets of n ∈ { 2 , 3 , 5 , 7 } n\in\{2,3,5,7\} condition views.

paragraphs.en: We train DensiTok separately for three pretrained backbones: AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , WorldMirror ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . Following WorldMirror, we randomly sample a patch-aligned input resolution for each training batch. We evaluate the models at a fixed resolution of 294 × 518 294\times 518 pixels. Also, we randomly sample training sequences, draw n n uniformly from { 2 , … , 8 } \{2,\ldots,8\} , and select the n n observed views uniformly without replacement. We train LAM-VAE and the DiT for 200k iterations each, then finetune the DiT for one-step inference for an additional 20k iterations. All training and evaluation are conducted on four NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPUs. Other training details are provided in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: To examine how the number of completed views affects reconstruction quality and efficiency, we vary the total number of views N N with n = 2 n=2 observed views ( Tab. 3 ). At N = n = 2 N=n=2 , no tokens are generated for unobserved views, allowing us to assess the effect of refining the original geometry tokens through LAM-VAE. The limited gains over the original AnySplat baseline indicate that most of DensiTok’s improvement comes from generating additional geometry tokens. Increasing N N generates tokens for more unobserved views and generally improves reconstruction quality, at the cost of longer runtime and higher peak GPU memory. The additional views provide the reconstruction heads with geometry tokens for a denser set of viewpoints while keeping the observed inputs fixed. In our experiments, gains diminish beyond N = 12 N=12 , making the tradeoff between quality and computational cost less favorable.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究已完成视图的数量如何影响重建质量和效率，我们调整了总视图数 N，其中 n = 2 为已观察的视图（表 3）。 当 N = n = 2 时，未观察的视图不会生成任何标记，这使我们能够评估通过 LAM-VAE 优化原始几何标记所产生的影响。 与原始的 AnySplat 基线相比，改进幅度有限，这表明 DensiTok 的大部分提升来自生成额外的几何标记。 增加 N 会为更多未观察的视图生成标记，通常能提升重建质量，但代价是运行时间更长、峰值 GPU 内存占用更高。 在保持已观察输入不变的同时，这些额外视图为重建头提供了更密集视角集合的几何标记。 在我们的实验中，当 N > 12 时，改进幅度逐渐减小，使得质量与计算成本之间的权衡变得不再有利。

paragraphs.en: DensiTok currently restricts geometry token augmentation to view interpolation and does not implement view extrapolation beyond the observed camera interval. Virtual cameras are interpolated between the first and last observed cameras, and our evaluation likewise considers novel views within this interval. Our results therefore do not establish reconstruction quality for extrapolated viewpoints. Future work could extend virtual camera sampling beyond the observed trajectory and adapt latent completion to the weaker visual constraints at these viewpoints. A key challenge is to infer newly visible geometry and appearance while maintaining consistency with the observed scene.
paragraphs.zh: DensiTok 目前将几何体标记增强限制在视图插值范围内，并未实现超出已观测相机范围的视图外推。 虚拟相机在首个和最后一个已观测相机之间进行插值，我们的评估同样只考虑该区间内的新视图。 因此，我们的结果并未验证外推视角的重建质量。 未来的工作可以将虚拟相机的采样范围扩展到已观测轨迹之外，并根据这些视角较弱的视觉约束调整潜在补全方法。 一个关键挑战是在保持与已观测场景一致性的同时，推断出新的可见几何体和外观。

paragraphs.en: DensiTok improves unposed feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting by completing the geometry tokens of unobserved views. paragraphs.en: The DiT in Sec. 3.3 stacks pairs of blocks, each applying frame attention followed by global attention, as in the VAE encoder transformer ( Sec. 3.2 ). Let d h d_{h} denote the DiT hidden width. A frame block attends independently to each view’s K × d h K\times d_{h} token matrix, whereas a global block attends jointly to all N N views by flattening their tokens into a single N ​ K × d h NK\times d_{h} matrix. Cross-view exchange therefore happens in the global blocks, where noisy unobserved views gather evidence from clean observed views. paragraphs.en: Following NoPoSplat ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , we estimate image overlap using bidirectional RoMa ( Edstedt et al., 2024 ) matching. We assign these ranges to sequences with probabilities 25 % 25\% , 50 % 50\% , and 25 % 25\% , respectively, and exclude sequences without a suitable interval in their assigned range. The resulting evaluation subsets follow these target proportions subject to the availability of eligible sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 NoPoSplat（Ye et al., 2025），我们使用双向 RoMa（Edstedt et al., 2024）匹配来估计图像重叠度。 第一张和最后一张视图之间的重叠度决定了某个区间的难度。 我们将区间分为三个重叠范围：(0.55, 0.80]、(0.30, 0.55] 以及 [0.05, 0.30]，其中重叠度越低表示共享的视觉证据越少。 我们分别以 25%、50% 和 25% 的概率将这些范围分配给序列，并排除其指定范围内没有合适区间的序列。 最终生成的评估子集遵循上述目标比例，具体取决于可用合格序列的数量。

paragraphs.en: The joint improvement in scene reconstruction and camera estimation reflects their dependence on a shared geometry representation. As described in Section A.2 , the pretrained camera head decodes the final camera poses from the completed geometry tokens. The predicted and interpolated cameras in Section 3.4 provide conditions for latent generation, while the final output cameras are predicted again from the enriched tokens. Geometry token completion therefore benefits both Gaussian reconstruction and camera localization and orientation, even though the pretrained camera head remains frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 场景重建与相机估计的联合改进反映了它们对共享几何表示的依赖关系。 如 A.2 节所述，预训练的相机头会从完成的几何标记中解码最终的相机姿态。 第 3.4 节中预测和插值得到的相机为潜在生成提供了条件，而最终的输出相机则再次从增强后的标记中预测得到。 因此，几何标记的完成既有利于高斯重建，也有助于相机的定位与定向，尽管预训练的相机头仍然保持冻结状态。

paragraphs.en: We compare DensiTok with existing feed-forward Gaussian Splatting models designed for sparse-view reconstruction, including pixelSplat ( Charatan et al., 2024 ) , MVSplat ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , DepthSplat ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , VolSplat ( Wang et al., 2025e ) , SelfSplat ( Kang et al., 2025 ) , PF3plat ( Hong et al., 2025 ) , SPFSplat ( Huang and Mikolajczyk, 2025 ) , NoPoSplat ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , Splatt3R ( Smart et al., 2024 ) , and FreeSplatter ( Xu et al., 2025b ) on RE10K and DL3DV. Most existing sparse-view methods have been evaluated at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution ( Charatan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Hong et al., 2025 ) , so we evaluate all methods, including DensiTok, at this resolution. For DensiTok, which requires input image dimensions divisible by 14 14 , we perform inference at 252 × 252 252\times 252 and resize the predictions to the 256 × 256 256\times 256 evaluation resolution. Because this resolution differs from that of our original evaluation, we perform test-view sampling again. The resulting sampling indices differ from those used in Tables 1 and 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RE10K 和 DL3DV 数据集上，将 DensiTok 与现有的、专为稀疏视角重建设计的前馈高斯溅射模型进行了比较，这些模型包括 pixelSplat (Charatan et al., 2024)、MVSplat (Chen et al., 2024a)、DepthSplat (Xu et al., 2025a)、VolSplat (Wang et al., 2025e)、SelfSplat (Kang et al., 2025)、PF3plat (Hong et al., 2025)、SPFSplat (Huang and Mikolajczyk, 2025)、NoPoSplat (Ye et al., 2025)、Splatt3R (Smart et al., 2024) 和 FreeSplatter (Xu et al., 2025b)。 大多数现有的稀疏视角方法都是在 256 × 256 分辨率下进行评估的 (Charatan et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024a; Xu et al., 2025a; Hong et al., 2025)，因此我们将所有方法（包括 DensiTok）都以此分辨率进行评估。 对于 DensiTok，其输入图像的尺寸必须能被 14 整除，因此我们在 252 × 252 分辨率下进行推理，并将预测结果调整到 256 × 256 的评估分辨率。 由于该分辨率与我们最初的评估分辨率不同，我们再次进行了测试视角采样。 由此得到的采样索引与表 1 和表 6 中使用的索引有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 shows that all three DensiTok variants outperform FreeSplatter in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on both datasets at all evaluated input counts, except for the DA3 variant in PSNR on DL3DV at n = 2 n=2 . None of the DensiTok variants requires input camera intrinsics or extrinsics. At n = 3 n=3 , all three variants also outperform NoPoSplat in every reported appearance and depth metric on both datasets. Among all evaluated methods, DepthSplat achieves the highest PSNR and lowest LPIPS on both datasets at n = 2 n=2 . DensiTok with AnySplat achieves the highest PSNR and lowest LPIPS on RE10K at n ∈ { 5 , 7 } n\in\{5,7\} , while DensiTok with WorldMirror achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on DL3DV at n ∈ { 3 , 5 , 7 } n\in\{3,5,7\} . The DA3 variant achieves the second-highest PSNR on RE10K at n = 5 n=5 and the second-lowest LPIPS on RE10K at n ∈ { 5 , 7 } n\in\{5,7\} and on DL3DV at n = 7 n=7 .

paragraphs.en: Most diffusion-based NVS methods aim to synthesize plausible content in unobserved regions and are typically evaluated with widely spaced input views. Our reconstruction task requires a minimum degree of overlap between input views, so we use more closely spaced inputs. This difference in view sampling can lead to modest discrepancies with the results reported in the original papers.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数基于扩散的 NVS 方法旨在未观察到的区域中合成合理的内容，并且通常使用间隔较宽输入视角进行评估。 我们的重建任务要求输入视角之间至少有一定的重叠程度，因此我们使用了间距更近的输入。 这种视角采样方式的不同可能导致与原始论文中报告的结果存在轻微差异。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 shows that all three DensiTok variants achieve higher PSNR and SSIM than the evaluated diffusion baselines on both datasets at every matching input count. DensiTok with DA3 achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on RE10K for n ∈ { 3 , 5 , 7 } n\in\{3,5,7\} , while the WorldMirror variant leads these metrics on DL3DV at every evaluated input count. The AnySplat variant achieves the lowest LPIPS on both datasets across all input counts. All three variants also outperform the diffusion baselines in LPIPS for n ∈ { 3 , 5 , 7 } n\in\{3,5,7\} . At n = 2 n=2 , GLD retains lower LPIPS than the DA3 variant on both datasets and the WorldMirror variant on DL3DV. The qualitative comparison in Figure 9 shows that the evaluated diffusion baselines can alter scene context and exhibit weaker geometric consistency with the observed scene. NVComposer changes the bookshelf composition and bed appearance, producing plausible content that departs from the target scene. GLD and Matrix3D better retain the overall layout, but the enlarged shelf ornament and bed-frame regions reveal local shape distortions. In these examples, DensiTok more closely preserves the scene content, object arrangement, and geometric structure of the ground-truth targets. DensiTok completes inference in under a second, while the evaluated diffusion baselines require tens of seconds to a few minutes. This yields speedups of tens to hundreds of times at matching input counts. At n = 2 n=2 , DensiTok requires 0.510 to 0.579 seconds compared with 76.824 seconds for GLD, yielding approximately 133 × 133\times to 151 × 151\times speedups across the three backbones. DensiTok therefore combines stronger image reconstruction metrics with substantially lower latency, making it more practical for fast novel-view synthesis.

paragraphs.en: One-step finetuning retains most of the rendering quality of the 50-evaluation reference while achieving a speedup of approximately 19 × 19\times . It also outperforms the unfinetuned model at one or eight evaluations. At the same single-evaluation cost, it achieves better PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS than both deterministic regression and one-step training from scratch on RE10K and DL3DV. These results support combining flow-matching pretraining with one-step finetuning for efficient latent completion.
paragraphs.zh: 单步微调在保持 50 次评估参考模型大部分渲染质量的同时，实现了约 19 × 19\times 的速度提升。 它在一次或八次评估中的表现也优于未微调的模型。 在单次评估成本相同的情况下，它在 RE10K 和 DL3DV 数据集上实现的 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 指标均优于确定性回归和从头单步训练。 这些结果支持将流匹配预训练与单步微调相结合，以实现高效的潜在空间补全。

paragraphs.en: Increasing the latent channel count from 4 4 to 16 16 expands the representational capacity of the latent space and relaxes the compression bottleneck. The 16-channel variant improves most appearance, camera, and depth metrics across both datasets and input counts. These results suggest that a wider latent representation can better preserve appearance and geometric information, although improvements are not uniform across all metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 将潜在通道数量从 4 4 增加到 16 16，可以扩展潜在空间的表示能力，并缓解压缩瓶颈。 在两个数据集和输入数量下，16 通道版本在大多数外观、相机和深度指标上均有提升。 这些结果表明，更宽的潜在表示能够更好地保留外观和几何信息，尽管并非所有指标都能得到一致的提升。

paragraphs.en: Keeping the Gaussian head fully frozen yields performance close to image embedding finetuning on both datasets. The gap in appearance and depth quality becomes negligible as the number of observed views n n increases. We attribute this trend to the smaller spacing between input views along the same camera trajectory. Closer input views provide better coverage in the warped color prior, reducing the impact of holes and the need for appearance adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 将高斯头部完全冻结，可在两个数据集上获得与图像嵌入微调相近的性能。 随着观测视角数量 n 的增加，外观和深度质量之间的差距变得可以忽略不计。 我们将这一趋势归因于沿同一相机轨迹输入视角之间的间距更小。 更近的输入视角能为扭曲的颜色先验提供更全面的覆盖，从而减少空洞的影响并降低外观自适应的需求。

paragraphs.en: Finetuning the entire Gaussian head further improves appearance and depth quality, while camera accuracy remains broadly similar across the three configurations. These gains are modest, and both the frozen head and image embedding finetuning retain comparable performance.
